id: \bDanny: You climbed all the way up here. Good! You passed my first test then.
en: \bDanny: You climbed all the way up here. Good! You passed my first test then.
it: \bDanny: Sei salito fin quassù. Bene! Allora hai superato la mia prima prova.

id: \bDanny: You've earned the Sea Ruby Badge.
en: \bDanny: You've earned the Sea Ruby Badge.
it: \bDanny: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Rubino Marino.

id: \bTM13 contains Ice Beam. It's a powerful Ice move that can freeze almost anything.
en: \bTM13 contains Ice Beam. It's a powerful Ice move that can freeze almost anything.
it: \bLa MT13 contiene Geloraggio. È una potente mossa di tipo Ghiaccio che può congelare quasi tutto.

id: \bDanny: I hope you continue to train as hard as you did in the mountain.
en: \bDanny: I hope you continue to train as hard as you did in the mountain.
it: \bDanny: Spero che continuerai ad allenarti duramente come hai fatto sulla montagna.

id: \rI will heal you before you battle.
en: \rI will heal you before you battle.

id: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.
en: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.
it: \rOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon siete in gran forma.
